label: Bible Study
prompt: No _____ that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness is of me, saith the LORD.
verse: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness is of me, saith the LORD.
note: A promise to God's servants — weapons may be formed, but they won't prosper.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of _____ fail, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Elijah.
verse: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Elijah.
note: The widow of Zarephath shared her last meal with Elijah — and her meal and oil never ran out.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river's side; and when she saw the ark among the _____, she sent her maid to fetch it.
verse: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river's side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.
note: The KJV says 'flags' for reeds — Pharaoh's daughter spotted the little ark tucked among them while going down to bathe.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And seek the peace of the _____ whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the LORD for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.
verse: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the LORD for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.
note: Jeremiah's letter to the exiles: pray for Babylon, because your welfare is tied up with hers.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: This know also, that in the last days _____ times shall come.
verse: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.
note: 'Perilous times' in the last days — then Paul lists them: lovers of self, lovers of money, lovers of pleasure.
